added.reason: imps-specific whole-job policy loaded only for job operations: stage gate runs created with parent ownership, bounded worker verification slots, coordinator verification fallback, gate-authoritative stage acceptance, the new final gate, pinned babysitter dependency for prs, pinned perspectives and legacy run recovery.

tests.reason: New Stage 4 imps coordinator-adapter coverage: operation routing, direct cheap operations, worker definition contracts, stated boundaries and one synthetic installed whole job through job_cli.py, the stage gate and the final gate.

operations.reason: Multi-stage work becomes one job (references/jobs.md); each stage keeps its own gate run created by the coordinator, and that run's validate stays the acceptance authority. A single bounded change may stay one direct gate run.

A job resumes by recovering its pinned imps entry through t3-plugins --job, reading the overview and reconciling handles. Runs without a job keep the legacy resume path; major-version-1 runs still need the previous package.
Direct: prints the read-only job overview, or the legacy run status/validate/report; never launches agents.
Cancels only owned job handles, confirms each stop, records it, cancels each stage gate run and then the job; artifacts are kept. Legacy runs keep their cancel path.
Cross-plugin dependency: the job declares babysitter at creation and loads the entry printed by t3-plugins --job JOB path babysitter; undeclared plugins are refused.
